The specification describes Spring Framework context but the actual user stories are about Spring Cloud Data Flow (SCDF) deployer SPIs (Service Provider Interfaces) - specifically about:
- U1: Submit PR for existing Mesos SPI work
- U2: Create separate repo for Lattice SPI
- U3: Create separate repo for K8s SPI
- U4: Create separate repo for Mesos SPI
- U5: Add "undeployed" status for CF (Cloud Foundry) SPI
- U6: Add "undeployed" status for Lattice SPI
- U7: Add support for "undeployed" status consistently across all deployers (for existing streams without deployment context)
- U8: Add "undeployed" status for k8s SPI

These stories appear to be from Spring Cloud Data Flow project history - the separation of deployer SPIs into separate repositories and the addition of UNDEPLOYED deployment status.

Let me break down the work:

1. **U1: Submit PR for Mesos SPI existing work** - This involves preparing the existing Mesos SPI code, cleaning it up, and submitting a pull request. Includes code review iterations.

2. **U2: Create separate repo for Lattice SPI** - Extract Lattice SPI code from the admin project, create new repository structure, set up build (Maven/Gradle), CI configuration, move tests, update documentation.

3. **U3: Create separate repo for K8s SPI** - Same as above for Kubernetes SPI.

4. **U4: Create separate repo for Mesos SPI** - Same as above for Mesos SPI.

5. **U5: Add "undeployed" status for CF SPI** - Add UNDEPLOYED enum value handling in the CF deployer's status logic, so apps that were never deployed report "undeployed" instead of "unknown". Unit tests.

6. **U6: Add "undeployed" status for Lattice SPI** - Same for Lattice deployer.

7. **U7: Add "undeployed" status consistently across all deployers** - This is a cross-cutting concern. It likely involves changes in the common deployer SPI / app deployer status handling (e.g., in spring-cloud-deployer or the Data Flow server) so that streams without deployment context return UNDEPLOYED. This could be a default implementation change in the SPI or in Data Flow core. This affects existing streams without deployment context.

8. **U8: Add "undeployed" status for k8s SPI** - Same for Kubernetes deployer.

Note U7 might subsume some of U5/U6/U8 work if done via a common default, but the stories mention per-SPI changes plus consistent support. I'll treat U5/U6/U8 as per-deployer implementations and U7 as the shared/core logic (e.g., in the data flow server runtime or the deployer SPI default methods) plus integration testing.

Also there's an overarching integration: after extracting repos, the admin project needs to depend on the new artifacts, update dependency management, etc. Maybe include an integration/release activity.

A1. Requirements analysis and design (understand current code structure, design repo extraction approach, design undeployed status semantics) - maybe 2 days.

A2. U1: Prepare and submit Mesos SPI PR (cleanup, tests, PR review iterations) - 3 days.

A3. U2: Extract Lattice SPI into separate repo (code migration, build setup, CI, tests migration, docs) - 4 days.

technical_and_design_decisions: Each deployer SPI (Lattice, Kubernetes, Mesos) will be extracted from the monolithic admin project into its own standalone Git repository following existing Spring Cloud project conventions (Maven build, shared spring-cloud-build parent, unchanged package names).
Repository extraction will copy the relevant modules along with their unit/integration tests, add a README and license files, and wire CI builds on the existing CI infrastructure.
After extraction, the admin project will be refactored to consume the SPIs as external Maven artifacts (dependency management) instead of embedded modules, removing the duplicated code.

For the 'undeployed' status work, each deployer's status() logic will return DeploymentState.undeployed when an application/stream has no associated deployment context (i.e., it was never deployed), instead of the current DeploymentState.unknown.

U7 will be implemented primarily as shared logic: a consistent default handling for missing deployment context in the common deployer SPI/server-side status aggregation, verified by integration tests across all deployers; per-SPI specific handling is covered by U5, U6 and U8.
The existing Mesos SPI work (U1) will be submitted as a pull request first so it can serve as the baseline content of the new Mesos SPI repository (U4).
Standard code review, unit testing and documentation updates are included in each activity's estimate.
assumptions: A single developer performs all work; estimates are effort (workdays), not calendar duration, and assume familiarity with the existing Spring Cloud Data Flow codebase.
The monolithic admin project currently bundles the CF, Lattice, Kubernetes and Mesos deployer SPI modules together with their tests, and the code compiles and tests pass before extraction.
The developer has the permissions/tooling needed to create new Git repositories, CI jobs and publish artifacts; organizational approval processes are out of scope.
The DeploymentState.undeployed enum value already exists in the common deployer SPI (or adding it is trivial and included in U7); the work is changing when each deployer returns it.
U5/U6/U8 cover only the per-deployer status logic change plus unit tests; cross-cutting consistency and handling of existing streams without deployment context is covered by U7.
U1 covers preparing, cleaning up and submitting the already-existing Mesos SPI work as a PR, including one to two review iterations, not developing it from scratch.
No major refactoring, performance work, or new features beyond the listed user stories are in scope.

activities.activity_description: Review the current admin project structure and the bundled SPI modules; define the repository extraction approach, the new repos' build/CI layout, and the semantics of the 'undeployed' status (when it applies versus 'unknown'), including the impact on existing streams without deployment context.

activities.activity_name: U1: Submit PR for existing Mesos SPI work
activities.activity_description: Clean up the existing Mesos SPI implementation, ensure tests pass, write/adjust documentation, open the pull request against the target repository, and address code review feedback through one to two iterations until merge.

activities.activity_name: U2: Create separate repository for Lattice SPI
activities.activity_description: Create the new Lattice SPI repository: extract the Lattice deployer module and its tests from the admin project, set up the Maven build with the appropriate parent and dependencies, configure CI, add README/license, verify the build and tests standalone, and remove the module from the admin project replacing it with an external dependency.

activities.activity_name: U3: Create separate repository for Kubernetes SPI
activities.activity_description: Create the new Kubernetes SPI repository: extract the K8s deployer module and its tests from the admin project, set up the Maven build, configure CI, add README/license, verify the standalone build and tests, and update the admin project to consume the external artifact.

activities.activity_name: U4: Create separate repository for Mesos SPI
activities.activity_description: Create the new Mesos SPI repository seeded with the merged PR content from U1: set up the build and CI, migrate/verify tests, add documentation, and switch the admin project to depend on the external Mesos SPI artifact.

activities.activity_name: U5: Add 'undeployed' status to CF SPI
activities.activity_description: Modify the Cloud Foundry deployer's status computation to return 'undeployed' when there is no deployment context for the application instead of 'unknown', and add/update unit tests covering the new behavior and regression coverage for other states.

activities.activity_name: U6: Add 'undeployed' status to Lattice SPI
activities.activity_description: Modify the Lattice deployer's status computation to return 'undeployed' when no deployment context exists instead of 'unknown', with corresponding unit tests.

activities.activity_name: U8: Add 'undeployed' status to Kubernetes SPI
activities.activity_description: Modify the Kubernetes deployer's status computation to return 'undeployed' when no deployment context exists instead of 'unknown', with corresponding unit tests.

activities.activity_name: U7: Consistent 'undeployed' status across all deployers
activities.activity_description: Implement the shared handling so that all deployers (and the server-side status aggregation) consistently report 'undeployed' for existing streams that have no deployment context associated with them; includes any change to the common deployer SPI defaults, server-side mapping logic, and integration tests verifying consistent behavior across CF, Lattice, K8s and Mesos deployers.

activities.activity_name: Integration, end-to-end verification and release coordination
activities.activity_description: Integrate the extracted SPI artifacts and the status changes into the admin project, run full end-to-end regression test suites, update user/reference documentation and release notes for the new repositories and the status behavior change, and prepare the coordinated release/milestone artifacts.
